Direction: Brush direction in object space. x/y/z: streaks run along that axis. radial: spokes around the Y axis. circular: rings around the Y axis.
Brushscale: Streak frequency across the brush direction. Higher = finer, denser brush lines.
Streakamt: Strength of the streak noise in the normal and brightness. 0 = smooth metal.
Roughalong: Roughness along the brush direction. Low values keep highlights tight along the grain.
Roughacross: Roughness across the brush direction. Higher values smear the highlight sideways across the grain (anisotropy).
Anodize: Heat-tint amount. 0 = raw metal in Basecolor, 1 = fully anodized titanium-style colour.
Heightmix: What drives the tint colour. 0 = view angle, 1 = object-space height (Y).
Tintrange: Number of tint palette cycles spanned across the surface. Higher = more colour bands.
Tintoffset: Start point in the tint palette (0-1). About 0.5 is blue.
Tintanim: Amplitude of the loopable sinusoidal drift of the tint palette over time. 0 = static colours.
Reflect: Gain on the environment reflection. 1 = normal, above 1 brighter.
Speed: Animation speed multiplier for the tint drift and streak animation. 0 freezes.
Envmix: Environment source. 0 = built-in procedural studio, 1 = the equirectangular map on in1.
Envrot: Rotates the environment around the vertical axis, as a 0-1 fraction of a full turn.
Envgain: Brightness multiplier of the environment lighting.
Accent: Strength of the red accent bar in the procedural studio environment. 0 = off.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Geometry: Preview geometry. both: sphere and torus knot. sphere: sphere only. knot: torus knot only.
Spin: Whole turns the preview geometry rotates per preview cycle. 0 = static.
Camdist: Preview camera distance from the geometry, in world units.
Backdrop: Brightness of the preview background. 0 = black.
Exposure: Preview exposure multiplier applied before tonemapping.
Vignette: Strength of the preview edge darkening. 0 = off.
